Good questions

Before you decide

How is my capital invested?

Your capital joins a single pool allocated across real estate, digital assets, tech and thematic equities, quantitative strategies and cash. The current allocation is shown above and updates from the ledger.

How do I know the valuations are real?

Each holding names its valuation source, such as a certified appraisal or a live price feed, and figures are backed by double-entry ledger snapshots. You can inspect them on the Portfolio Holdings page.

What are the risks?

All investments carry risk and you can lose capital. Digital assets and speculative positions can fall sharply. The stress test shows how the pool responds to shocks, and analysts are happy to walk you through it.

Can I withdraw my money?

Withdrawal terms depend on your agreement and the liquidity of the pool. Ask an analyst on the Care Desk for the specifics before you invest.

Who will I actually talk to?

The analysts who run the numbers staff the Customer Care Desk, and members can also join the private pool room with the super admin inside Members Connect.

Executive Background & Investment Philosophy

Michael brings over 18 years of cross-asset portfolio management, quantitative hedging, and macro endowment leadership to Ledgerwell. Before founding Ledgerwell's fiduciary syndication framework, he spent seven years at PIMCO directing multi-asset strategies, navigating zero-interest-rate environments and subsequent tightening regimes with strict capital preservation parameters. At Ledgerwell, Michael enforces the 25% hard asset category caps, directs liquidity buffers via US Treasury money market funds, and chairs the bi-weekly LP risk and macro review committee.

Detailed Professional Experience & Institutional Track Record

Managing Director — Global Multi-Asset & Alternative Strategies
PIMCO • Newport Beach / New York • 2015 – 2022

Spearheaded $4.2B in multi-asset credit, inflation-hedging, and opportunistic real asset sleeves for institutional pension plans, sovereign wealth clients, and high-net-worth endowments. Co-authored the firm's quarterly Macro Outlook and generated +14.2% annualized net returns across the 2020 liquidity shock through disciplined systematic rebalancing and counter-cyclical liquidity deployment.

Vice President — Quantitative Investment Strategies (QIS)
Goldman Sachs Asset Management (GSAM) • New York • 2010 – 2015

Managed factor-based risk mitigation strategies, tail-risk volatility hedges, and North American equity conviction baskets for over $1.8B in LP capital. Designed algorithmic rebalancing blotters that minimized transaction slippage and pioneered proprietary liquidity-stress simulations.

Senior Macro Strategist & Quantitative Associate
Bridgewater Associates • Westport, CT • 2006 – 2010

Built long-term sovereign debt cycle models, currency cross-correlation algorithms, and liquidity forecasting telemetry for Ray Dalio's Pure Alpha and All Weather investment research groups.

Fiduciary Governance Oath

Under the Uniform Prudent Investor Act (UPIA), our officers owe an undivided duty of loyalty to pool participants. All investment actions require formal recorded rationale, strict adherence to asset caps (maximum 25% cryptocurrency/mining, minimum 20% cash equivalents), and mandatory disclosure of personal partner holdings.
